=== functions and labels | -g
	.text
	.globl f
	.type f, %function
f:
	ret
	.size f, .-f
_g:
	nop
__h:
	nop
	.data
d:
	.byte 1
=== a macro in a repeat | -g
	.macro two a
	mov x0, #\a
	mov x1, #\a
	.endm
	.text
	.rept 2
	two 1

	two 2
	.endr
	ret
=== sections, DWARF 3 | --gdwarf-3
	.text
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	nop
	.section .text.c,"ax",%progbits
	ret
	.section .rodata,"a",%progbits
x:
	.long 1
=== sections, DWARF 4 | --gdwarf-4
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
b:
	nop
	.text
t:
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	nop
=== sections, DWARF 2 | --gdwarf-2
	.text
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	nop
=== a source file name | -g
	.file "hello.c"
	.text
	ret
=== a source file name in DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.file "hello.c"
	.text
	ret
=== a pushsection | -g
	.text
	nop
	.pushsection .text.b,"ax",%progbits
	nop
	.popsection
	nop
